item.title: 2023 AGM for REAP Central Plateau
item.description: Kia ora! The 2023 AGM for REAP Central Plateau will be held at 5pm Tuesday 16 May 2023 at 73 Titiraupenga Street, Taupo. A notice of agenda has been sent to all members whose addresses are known. Board Elections 2023 Please call 07 378 8109 or email reception@reapcentralplateau.nz to RSVP. All are welcome!

item.title: Wairakei Primary presents parent workshop sponsored by REAP with Kathryn Berkett
item.description: Kia ora! Wairakei Primary and REAP are hosting a parent workshop with Kathryn Berkett. Entry by gold coin donation. March 7, 2023 6.30-7pm Taupo Primary School All are welcome!
